lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Ordered vertical columns of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a grid-like configuration across the mid-to-posterior lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Broad vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with faint horizontal bands, with the primary high-luminance blobs serving as geometric anchor nodes at each intersection.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient consisting of a light-reflecting dorsal edge and a shadowed ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense concentration of small, high-frequency circular white spots located on the dorsal surface of the left pectoral fin and the cranial region anterior to the gill slits.
